mapper.select: select id, username, password, nickname, avatar, role, status, wechat_openid, wechat_unionid, last_login_time, create_time, update_time from t_user where username = #{username}
select id, username, password, nickname, avatar, role, status, wechat_openid, wechat_unionid, last_login_time, create_time, update_time from t_user where id = #{id}
select id, username, password, nickname, avatar, role, status, wechat_openid, wechat_unionid, last_login_time, create_time, update_time from t_user where wechat_openid = #{openid}
mapper.insert: insert into t_user (username, password, nickname, avatar, role, status, wechat_openid, wechat_unionid, last_login_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{role}, #{status}, #{wechatOpenid}, #{wechatUnionid}, #{lastLoginTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
